failure_clusters.explanation: The test requires rejection of an internal waveform EVLR solely because global-encoding bit 1 is clear. Supplied LAS 1.4 Table 4 calls this bit deprecated and only specifies its meaning when set; the separate public-header waveform offset locates the internal EVLR. No supplied prompt adds a mandatory-set rule. Rust src/las.rs:199-203 intentionally uses the valid offset when that bit is clear, and src/tests.rs:234 contains an explicit local regression for that reading. Acceptance/rejection of only this deprecated bit should remain unscored; a candidate tests the unambiguous contradiction of internal packet data with the explicit external-storage bit.

payload.notes: Voluntarily completed a substantial dependency-free Rust inspect/render implementation. The final transcript confirms 18 unit tests plus one CLI integration test passing and a successful release build. Source review confirmed exact 64-bit JSON numbers, binary bounds checks, all point formats, metadata and extra-byte validation, and the deliberate deprecated-internal-bit interpretation described above.
